Alex: quick question — when we talk about API error semantics for the generation endpoints, do we want to standardize on 400 vs 422 for validation issues, and which 4xx/5xx should be considered retryable?
Maria: my vote: 400 for syntactic / parse errors (bad JSON, missing required field), 422 for semantic validation (prompt too long for the model config, incompatible params). keeps intent clear.
Kevin: +1 to that split. also we should call out 429 explicitly for rate limits and make it retryable with exponential backoff + Respect `Retry-After`.
Jen: nit — some clients treat 422 as "client bug" and never retry. we need docs to say when 422 can be fixed client-side vs when it's a transient model-config mismatch.
Alex: good point. example cases:
```
{ "error": { "code": "validation_error", "message": "prompt exceeds max_tokens for model-small (max 2048)", "field": "prompt", "type": "semantic" } }
```
If that comes back, client probably needs to truncate or pick a different model -> not retry.
Maria: agreed. propose: 400 = syntactic (non-retryable), 422 = semantic (non-retryable by default, but add `retryable": true` for specific cases?), 429 = rate limit (retryable), 503/502 = infra transient (retryable with backoff), 500 = we should inspect but treat as retryable unless we know it's an input issue.
Kevin: I'd avoid ad-hoc `retryable` flags unless we have a clear rule-set. Instead: include `error.kind` enum with values like ["validation", "quota", "transient", "auth"]. Clients map kinds -> retry policy. Keeps semantics decoupled from status code.
Jen: ooh yes that'd help SDKs. sample envelope suggestion: 
```
{
  "error": {
    "code": "rate_limit",
    "kind": "quota",
    "message": "Exceeded requests per minute",
    "retry_after": 30
  },
  "request_id": "req_ABC123"
}
```
deploy-bot: canary deploy 2026-02-14 04:32 UTC completed for runtime v2.3.1 — no alerts during window.
Alex: sweet — so action items: 1) I will update the API contract doc to include `error.kind` with mapping guidance, plus examples for 400 vs 422 and a short table for retry semantics. 2) Jen / Kevin can review SDK mapping PR. 3) Maria will add a section on "how to fix" for common validation errors (truncate vs change model).
Maria: I'll draft the "how to fix" list. can we add `x-request-id` header to all error responses too? makes tracing easier.
Kevin: yes please add `X-Request-Id` (server-generated) and keep `request_id` in body. also include `Retry-After` for 429/503 when appropriate.
Alex: thanks all. I'll open PR and reference this thread /issue #2345. ping me if you want anything specific included. :thumbsup:"
